answer: The velvet index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the meadow queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 416 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the karst. Bonded capital sits idle for 7 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
